title: Close the direct584 commuting-retiming family with port-to-target paths
body:
Direct deletion of entering helper 584 is an exact arbitrary-dirty scalar identity, but checking a few placements left its retiming family open. This adds a complete finite cover on both exact PR3133 provider words: all 1,002 contact classes per provider fail a literal input-port-to-target-output path test. The paths avoid every native boundary, so changing existing native charts/phases or helper entrance/terminal frames cannot repair this fixed scalar family.

Only `research/direct584-commuting-retiming-cover/` is added. It contains the written completeness argument, pinned source inputs, fixed path certificates, a standalone rational free-operator interpreter, a literal consecutive-touch checker, and the registered replay hook. The checker imports no predecessor auditor or optimization graph. This is a scoped finite obstruction, not a supplier, higher κ, global barrier, or selected-frontier change. A changed scalar consumer network or added/moved native slot remains open.

Validation covers 2,004 port-to-target certificates, complete dirty-state forward/dual replay of the original-cut and both extreme representatives on 631 inputs and 90 private buffers, and 20 semantic rejection controls. Independent AI review uses rational elementary-matrix multiplication and pairwise interval feasibility to reconstruct the 1,002-class cover through different rules. Registered replay passed in 154.49s; optimized Git-free replay of the committed 17-file scientific export passed in 170.76s. Exact publication-byte/source-history and final export-integrity checks pass. Scientific commit: `743475296e3ea35461aeed1ec25d0e5d7c6ad070`; publication commit: `e3dc9c1660bfec0501dd7522f44a21746f9b89e2` differs only in the validation receipt. The separate AI coverage-review script remains local and is not claimed as a public replay input. Hosted CI will be reported separately after submission; no manual reruns are requested.

Credit: dcharb78/PR3133, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015 and the source's complete credited lineage.
